title: 水處理臭氧氧化
summary: 本課以臭氧氣液傳質、需求、反應與副產物為主線，從處理目的與前驅物、原料氣與乾燥邊界、產生、注入與尾氣、需求與殘留衰減進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops ozone gas-liquid transfer, demand, reaction and byproducts through ten connected units, beginning with treatment goals and precursors, feed-gas conditioning boundary, generation, injection and off-gas, demand and residual decay. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
